name: context-caddy
description: A lightweight VS Code extension that exposes Copilot tools for context and request management.

languageModelTools.name: yourpublisher_taskStateVerifier
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Task-state verification tool. The model should call this before user-facing responses when it needs the user to confirm or restate the current task state, approval, or request context. This tool does not expect model-provided input. Instead, it prompts the user for task-state text at invocation time and returns that user-provided text unchanged for the model to use.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Ask the user to confirm the current task state and return that text to the model.
